name: Play it again
author: Bob Corporaal
description: Two smart playlists to help you rediscover dusty corners of your libary. Play later to track albums to play again. Forgotten records to bring up your least recently played albums.

subsonicAPI.reason: Read and modify the Play Later and Forgotten Records playlists

users.reason: Receive scrobble events per user and iterate users for scheduled rebuilds

kvstore.reason: Track per-user played-track counts between sessions

cache.reason: Cache playlist IDs to avoid redundant API calls

scheduler.reason: Schedule periodic rebuild of the Forgotten Records playlist

playlater_enabled.title: Enable Play later
playlater_enabled.description: When enabled, the plugin watches the Play Later playlist and removes albums as you scrobble them. When disabled, the plugin leaves the playlist untouched.

playlater_playlist_name.title: Play later playlist name
playlater_playlist_name.description: Exact name of the existing 'Play Later' playlist to watch (case-insensitive).

playlater_threshold.title: Album removal threshold (%)
playlater_threshold.description: Percentage of album tracks that must be scrobbled before the complete album is removed from the playlist (1–100).

forgottenrecords_enabled.title: Enable Forgotten records
forgottenrecords_enabled.description: When enabled, the plugin maintains the Forgotten Records playlist by scheduling rebuilds and removing albums as you scrobble them. When disabled, no scheduled or scrobble-driven rebuilds run.

forgottenrecords_album_count.title: Albums in the playlist
forgottenrecords_album_count.description: Number of complete albums to include in the Forgotten Records playlist.

forgottenrecords_album_pool_size.title: Album pool size
forgottenrecords_album_pool_size.description: The number of least recently scrobbled albums to randomly select from for the playlist.

forgottenrecords_threshold.title: Album removal threshold (%)
forgottenrecords_threshold.description: Percentage of album tracks that must be scrobbled before the complete album is removed from the playlist (1–100).

forgottenrecords_schedule.title: Rebuild schedule (Cron)
forgottenrecords_schedule.description: Cron expression for how often the Forgotten Records playlist is rebuilt. Default: daily at midnight (0 0 * * *). Requires Navidrome restart to take effect.

forgottenrecords_count.title: Number of playlists
forgottenrecords_count.description: How many Forgotten Records playlists to maintain (1–5).

forgottenrecords_playlist_name_1.title: Playlist 1 name
forgottenrecords_playlist_name_1.description: Name of the first Forgotten Records playlist. Leave empty for auto-numbered name.

forgottenrecords_tags_1.title: Playlist 1 tags
forgottenrecords_tags_1.description: Comma-separated genre tags to filter albums (e.g. rock, jazz). Leave empty for all genres.

forgottenrecords_playlist_name_2.title: Playlist 2 name
forgottenrecords_playlist_name_2.description: Name of the second Forgotten Records playlist. Leave empty for auto-numbered name.

forgottenrecords_tags_2.title: Playlist 2 tags
forgottenrecords_tags_2.description: Comma-separated genre tags to filter albums (e.g. rock, jazz). Leave empty for all genres.

forgottenrecords_playlist_name_3.title: Playlist 3 name
forgottenrecords_playlist_name_3.description: Name of the third Forgotten Records playlist. Leave empty for auto-numbered name.

forgottenrecords_tags_3.title: Playlist 3 tags
forgottenrecords_tags_3.description: Comma-separated genre tags to filter albums (e.g. rock, jazz). Leave empty for all genres.

forgottenrecords_playlist_name_4.title: Playlist 4 name
forgottenrecords_playlist_name_4.description: Name of the fourth Forgotten Records playlist. Leave empty for auto-numbered name.

forgottenrecords_tags_4.title: Playlist 4 tags
forgottenrecords_tags_4.description: Comma-separated genre tags to filter albums (e.g. rock, jazz). Leave empty for all genres.

forgottenrecords_playlist_name_5.title: Playlist 5 name
forgottenrecords_playlist_name_5.description: Name of the fifth Forgotten Records playlist. Leave empty for auto-numbered name.

forgottenrecords_tags_5.title: Playlist 5 tags
forgottenrecords_tags_5.description: Comma-separated genre tags to filter albums (e.g. rock, jazz). Leave empty for all genres.

elements.text: Use playlist to track albums you want to play later. As you play tracks the albums are automatically removed from the playlist.
The Forgotten records playlist is automatically filled with a selection of your least recently played albums.
If you want to update it now, toggle the plugin off and on again. The playlist refreshed every time the plugin is toggled on.
